name_note: The NCBI labels on the genomes GTDB places in this genus are mostly unnamed or Ruminococcus, a different genus; only sources that use the name Huintestinicola are cited here.

sentences.text: Huintestinicola butyrica was among the anaerobic gut taxa reported from metagenomic analysis of internal tissues of a 5300-year-old alpine glacier mummy.
The authors of that study reported that these taxa showed high similarity to ancestral, non-Westernized human gut communities.
A study of faecal samples from Holstein cows reported Huintestinicola among eight genus-level bacteria identified as specific to both groups of cows that did not become pregnant.
